data.text:
Implementation complete on matchday/tk-hai, commit 202dc9f.

WHAT LANDED
- extensions/hub.ts — the omp extension factory (docs/05 §Entry). Brain guard: OMP_HUB_BRAIN=1 → early-return before any pi.on/registerTool/registerCommand (guard 1; smoke-verified with a recording stub: zero registrations). Registers /hub-start /hub-stop /hub-agent + session_start/session_shutdown widget lifecycle. Widget key exported as WIDGET_KEY = 'omp-hub-stream' (tk-z9a renders into this slot; claimed at session_start + /hub-start, cleared at /hub-stop + shutdown).
- extensions/hub_env.ts — env boundary: OMP_HUB_SOCK (default ~/.hub/hub.sock, dataRoot derived), OMP_HUB_BRAIN ('1' only), OMP_HUB_MODEL, OMP_BIN (default omp), OMP_HUB_AGENT ('1' only). Accepts an injected env record; lib never reads process.env.
- extensions/hub_local.ts — the composition hub.ts drives: json_store, jsonl_store, memory_bus, status-backed attention store, timeout scheduler, omp_agent runtime, unix_socket server; injects into hub_core + tk-jwx startWatcher. reportToRaw translates docs/02 reporter frames → RawOmpEvent (unknown frames dropped silently). Overrides seam (runtime/socket/watcher) keeps tests on fakes.
- extensions/hub.test.ts — 16 tests: brain guard zero-registration; /hub-start binds the real socket (raw client hello→cmd→reply asserted through frames, not sleeps) + brain spawned via injectable AgentRuntime fake; /hub-stop kills children + closes socket + peer rows survive with NO archive dir written (docs/05 §Shutdown); agent toggle spawn/adopt/stop + buildAgentSpec acp/OMP_HUB_AGENT env + guard-5 refusal; env defaults/overrides/env-free-lib; reportToRaw table; widget key contract.
- lib/runtime/hub_core.ts — hub-side runtime: handleEvent normalize pipeline (log append → single status.json rewrite → bus publish), CommandSurface (list/send/spawn/kill/attention list+dismiss/answer/assign; tool+archive+logTail+summaries refuse for now), spawnBrain/spawnWorker/disposeChildren, self-delivery denial (guard 3).
- lib/adapters: memory_bus (EventBus), attention_store (over StatusStore; idempotent raise per (session,kind); guard-6 selfId rejection; resolution lines to summaries), timeout_scheduler (Scheduler).
- lib/adapters/unix_socket.ts: added deliverTo bridge (targets hello client id 'plugin' — the tk-epx seam for inbound deliver frames); start() now takes an optional path for fake parity.
- lib/package.json: ./runtime/* exports subpath. tsconfig now includes extensions/. Root package.json: pi-coding-agent + pi-tui added to devDependencies (typecheck only; peers stay optional).

SEAMS FOR PARALLEL TASKS (not implemented here by design)
- tk-epx (reporter): socket onReport → hub_local.handleReport is the inbound frame entry; self-feed = call core.handleEvent directly when hubActive && sessionId === selfSessionId (state.selfSessionId via the factory closure); outbound deliver frames arrive via server.deliverTo('plugin', sessionId, text).
- tk-z9a (widget render): own the WIDGET_KEY slot via ctx.ui.setWidget; subscribe to the bus the hub core publishes (topic 'log') for render triggers.

VERIFICATION: bun test 352 pass / 0 fail (x3 stable), tsc --noEmit exit 0 (extensions included), lib bun build clean. Leave OPEN for validator.

REJECT: verdict FAIL — two P1 behavioral breaks against claimed acceptance #4, plus gaps. Evidence: 352/0 x4 runs (incl. mutations), tsc --noEmit 0.

P1-1 watcher never started. extensions/hub_local.ts:200-212 composes startWatcher but .start() is called NOWHERE in the repo (grep: only extensions/hub.ts:52 local.start()). /hub-start leaves the watcher dormant: no EventBus subscription, no flush loop, snapshot.agentSession never written, supervision dead. Claim 'wires the watcher runtime (startWatcher... actually called with the composition)' is false at runtime — composition only.

P1-2 /hub-agent spawns the wrong child flavor. extensions/hub.ts:97-101 calls buildAgentSpec (acp, OMP_HUB_AGENT=1) then DISCARDS it except .name, spawning via state.local.runtime which hub_local.ts:84-90 hardcodes flavor:'rpc' → production child gets --mode rpc + OMP_HUB_BRAIN=1, a brain, not the docs/05 §Agent spawn acp peer. Tests blind: fake runtime ignores flavor; only spec.name asserted.

P2-1 /hub-stop (extensions/hub.ts:72-85) resets agentActive/agentName without killing the agent child (agent spawned outside core.children, disposeChildren never sees it) → orphaned omp process; a following /hub-agent spawns a second agent, violating 'at most one'.

P2-2 deliverTo misroutes with >1 plugin client. lib/adapters/unix_socket.ts:243-260 picks targets[0] by client id only; hub_local.ts:130+135 hardcode clientId 'plugin' and drop sessionId from routing. N sessions connected (the normal case) → send/answer deliver user text into the WRONG session.

P2-3 guard-5 (/hub-start refused in agent session, extensions/hub.ts:64-67) has NO test; spot mutation (if(false)) survives the full suite 4/5 runs. Guard-1 mutation correctly caught (1 fail). Guard-3/guard-6 verified behaviorally by me (send-to-self and raise-selfId both denied: 'cannot deliver to the hub itself' / 'attention items cannot be raised for the hub agent itself') but have no direct tests for the real attention_store/core — watcher.test.ts guard-6 uses a fake store reimplementing the rejection.

P2-4 reportToRaw (extensions/hub_local.ts:63-95) drops title from session_start (docs/05: frame carries sessionId,title,cwd) and model/kind (docs/02 payload) → roster rows untitled until first user message.

P3: attention_store.list() returns a module-level cache that is empty until the first mutation (unwarmed) — a silent-empty footgun for any future caller; widget slot claimed pre-/hub-start (docs/05 §Widget says hub-mode only).

What is good: pipeline order (log append → single atomic status rewrite → bus publish) correct per docs/02; no-archive-on-stop proven by test (archive dir absent, peer row survives); env boundary clean — zero process.env reads in lib (omp_agent only spreads process.env into the child env, host-resolved values override); brain-guard ordering correct and mutation-verified; unix_socket changes additive; scope respected (no web/, no cli/ changes).

Required before re-review: (1) call watcher.start()/stop() from the /hub-start lifecycle (or route agent spawn through the watcher path so agentSession + supervision live), (2) make /hub-agent actually spawn acp via a spec-driven runtime or a second runtime instance, (3) kill the agent child in /hub-stop, (4) test guard-5 refusal + real attention_store selfId rejection + core self-delivery denial, (5) pass title/model through reportToRaw, (6) deliverTo must address by sessionId (defer explicit design to tk-epx but do not ship first-conn-wins).

Fix round addressing every REJECT finding (commit 7fd48ff, pushed to matchday/tk-hai). Evidence: bun test 372 pass / 0 fail x3 stable (was 354/2), tsc --noEmit 0, mutation checks re-run per finding.

P1-1 watcher never started — FIXED. extensions/hub_local.ts start() composes startWatcher with real options (runtime: agentRuntimeFor() = the acp runtime; spawnOnStart: false per docs/05 agent-optional) and CALLS watcher.start() (subscribe + catch-up + loop); stop() calls watcher.stop() before core.disposeChildren() and clears the adopted status.agentSession so a restart cannot re-adopt a dead id. Tests: '/hub-start STARTS the watcher' (start spy=1 on hubStart, stop=1 on hubStop, was failing pre-fix) + '/hub-start composes the watcher with the acp agent runtime (not the rpc brain runtime)' asserting composed opts.runtime identity. Mutation check: removing await watcher.start() FAILS the suite.

P1-2 acp flavor discarded — FIXED. /hub-agent resolves buildAgentSpec(env) (guard-5) then routes through local.watcherSpawn() → watcher.spawnAgent() → the dedicated acp AgentRuntime (docs/06: one supervised spawn path). hub_local composes one runtime per flavor: rpc for brain/workers, acp (OMP_HUB_AGENT=1) for the agent. Tests assert art.spawns[0].name='hub-watcher', model undefined-omitted, rt (brain runtime) sees ONLY the brain; watcher composition test asserts opts.runtime === agentRuntime and !== rpc runtime; watcher.test.ts asserts buildSpawnSpec shape (--mode acp, OMP_HUB_AGENT=1, OMP_HUB_MODEL when set). Mutation: composing the watcher with the rpc runtime FAILS 3 tests.

P2-1 stop-kills-agent — FIXED. /hub-stop calls killAgent() (acp runtime.kill(agentName)) before local.stop(); agentActive/agentName reset only after the kill. Tests: '/hub-stop with a running agent terminates the child and re-start re-spawns fresh' — spawn→stop→art.killed=['hub-watcher']→restart→toggle→art.spawns.length=2→stop→killed=['hub-watcher','hub-watcher'] (no orphan, no double). Mutation: removing await killAgent() FAILS 2 tests.

P2-2 deliverTo sessionId routing — FIXED. unix_socket connections now track session ownership: reporter frames session_start/session_end move the sessionId to/from that connection; deliverTo(sessionId, text) targets the reporter OWNING the sessionId; when no owner exists but exactly one reporter is connected it is the unambiguous fallback; with 2+ reporters and no owner it refuses unknown-session. No first-conn-wins. Tests (real socket): two plugin clients with sessions s-alpha/s-beta — interleaved delivers land per-owner (alpha gets only its 2 frames, beta only its 1); after session_end from another conn, delivers to s-alpha fail unknown-session; fallback + ambiguity-refusal covered. Mutation: reverting to first-conn-wins FAILS 2 tests. Explicit cross-session design stays tk-epx's to refine — the anti-misroute requirement is met.

P2-3 guard tests — DONE. (a) guard-5: '/hub-start inside a hub-agent session is refused' asserts text 'this session is the hub agent' AND composed===0 AND state untouched; mutation if(false) on the guard FAILS the suite. (b) real attention_store guard-6: new lib/adapters/attention_store.test.ts over REAL json stores (no fake reimplementation) — raise with selfId → denied 'attention items cannot be raised for the hub agent itself', status.json untouched; selfIds resolved at call time (late-adopted agent id still rejected); peer raise lands att-1; idempotent re-raise updates text, id stable. (c) real hub_core guard-3: new lib/runtime/hub_core.test.ts — send to selfSessionId through the REAL CommandSurface → denied 'cannot deliver to the hub itself', deliverTo bridge never invoked; empty self id does not deny peer sends (fails unknown-session instead, routing not guard).

P2-4 reportToRaw title/model — FIXED. session_start frames pass title/model into RawOmpEvent (absent/empty omitted, exactOptionalPropertyTypes-safe); domain session_start event + newSessionRecord/applyEvent carry them into status.json. Tests: unit table (with/without/empty) + end-to-end frame→status row assertions (s-titled gets title 'deploy canary', model 'm-1'). Mutation: dropping the title spread FAILS 2 tests.

P3 noted, not blocking: attention_store list() cache warms on first mutation (new test asserts list() sees a raised item); widget-claim timing left as-is per current docs/05 §Widget reading — flag for tk-z9a if the hub-mode-only interpretation is confirmed.

Scope: no web/, no cli/ changes. Left OPEN for validator.
